summary: NutriSync AI end-to-end test pass 1. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (health, protocol-gpt, protocol-gemini optimal zero-pill, protocol-gemini recovery, OCR with real generated JPEG label). Frontend: all requested flows work — dashboard readiness ring/deltas/chrono-stack/product-specific dosing, check-off marks intake and decrements stock, Sync & Re-Analyze regenerates, theme toggle (system/light/dark), region chips (US/IN/UK/EU/GLOBAL), API key inputs Save, telemetry presets (acute_stress → stress-banner + start-breath-pacer; rest_balanced → zero-pill-card), breath pacer (timer/phase/toggle/close working when opened directly at /breath), stash filters + steppers + delete + FAB + manual Add Supplement, Trends metric-segmented (deep/hrv) with efficacy insight, and both Emergent providers (gpt-5.4 & gemini-3.1-pro-preview) hit the FastAPI proxy and update generatedBy on the dashboard.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the in-dashboard 'Start 2-min Cyclic Sighing' button while running inside the automated Playwright session did not visibly navigate to /breath in one pass (breath-timer/breath-phase/toggle/close not visible after tap). Direct navigation to /breath works perfectly (timer counts down, pause/resume/close all functional). Likely an Expo Router web-preview push edge case rather than a functional defect. Please retest manually in the emulator; if it reproduces, consider replacing router.push with a Link or router.navigate.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: Invalid DOM property `transform-origin` — should be `transformOrigin`. Coming from a react-native-web style prop; low impact but should be fixed. Reference: likely in ReadinessRing or an SVG transform prop.
Console warning: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` — RN 0.74+ deprecation. Search for `pointerEvents=` in components and move to style.

Console warning: `shadow*` style props are deprecated, use `boxShadow`. Multiple components (Card, FAB, ScreenHeader) use shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius which are deprecated on web. Migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+ compatibility.

Console warning: Animated: useNativeDriver not supported (falls back to JS). Web-only harmless, but if react-native-reanimated worklets are meant for animations, some Animated API usage remains — audit and standardize on Reanimated.

action_items: Investigate/verify the in-app 'Start 2-min Cyclic Sighing' navigation from the dashboard StressBanner (works via /breath direct URL). Confirm router.push('/breath') fires on the button in the actual runtime.
Fix RN deprecation warnings: replace `pointerEvents` prop with style, replace `shadow*` with `boxShadow`, fix `transform-origin` → `transformOrigin` in the offending SVG/style.
(Optional) Consider adding `wholeFoodNote` to the schema requirement docs — the LLM currently returns it correctly on optimal state.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses `emergentintegrations` correctly; only concern is the LLM streaming loop has no timeout — a hung upstream would hang the API. Consider wrapping `_collect` with `asyncio.wait_for`.
backend/server.py OCR uses model `gemini-3-flash-preview` — hard-coded; consider making the model configurable via env for easy rollback.
Client-only app: on web preview, AsyncStorage seeds work as documented; state hydration behaviour is correct.
Cabinet 'delete' currently uses soft-delete (deletedAt); this is fine, but the toast says 'removed' — clarify UX if intentional.
